title: Load and retain twelve polarity-marked cells
instruction: Load every blue cell into the twelve-slot holder with its orange positive end matching the orange mark for that slot. Put the retaining plate over the cells and release the completed holder.
context: A repetition-horizon prototype for repeated polarity-sensitive seating with final mechanical retention.

scoring: Each of 13 outcome conditions earns 1/13; all conditions and numeric tolerances are listed in README.md and scene.json. Full score requires all conditions, all task bodies at <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, conservative robot clearance >=0.02 m for one continuous second. Before the hold completes, credit is capped at 0.95. Any lost part, fixture displacement, violated preservation invariant or penetration above 0.002 m permanently scores zero.
run_limit: 6000 controls at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds), provisional budget
reset_notes: Reset the native environment, restore every body and joint to scene.json, settle, then clear scorer history. Two independent full-score trials remain required.
fidelity: Engineering draft; unvalidated rigid primitives and passive joints. A positive capture for the retaining plate is missing. Cell polarity marks on the holder and contact-compression tolerances require completion before model evaluation. Twelve repetitions alone do not clear novelty; an independently justified task redesign is required.
